summary: Participants debate whether to separate finite vectors from fixed-length lists, how to name the type, and note that performance gains are unlikely, with enforcement left to engines. 1.18.2 1.19.0 Manu proposes a patch release of Parquet Java 1.18.2 to include several critical fixes and dependency updates. The community, including Fokko and Steve, supports the release and is ready to review the backport PRs. The discussion focuses on finalizing the release and ensuring all updated dependencies are compatible.
